about: Multi-step plan for a detached ADU in Anaheim. Documents: the made-up applicant's packet; Anaheim's ADU Submittal Requirements Checklist (Z412, Nov 2025); the ADU Express Application (Revised 10/2/2025); and Developer Impact Fees B802 (Oct 2026). Target texts are verbatim from their documents' text layers (data/processed/*-lines.json); boxes are [x, y, w, h] in PDF points, top-left origin. Z412 boxes are Team 1's; form boxes are the form's table cells (label plus blank); the B802 box is the ADU row and its note. targets.label: Checklist overview
targets.text: Planning staff reviews Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units (JADUs) to determine compliance with applicable zoning code requirements during the Building Division’s plan check review process. This checklist provides an overview of the Planning Services Division’s submittal requirements, in addition to the Building Division’s plan submittal requirements. All accessory dwelling unit requirements can be found in Anaheim Municipal Code (AMC) Section 18.38.015. Visit Anaheim.net/ADUheim for detailed information on developing ADUs in Anaheim and for updates on special programs and incentives that support ADU development.

targets.label: ADU Express Program
targets.text: For new detached ADUs, your property may be eligible for the ADU Express Program which provides one day permitting and zero design costs. Visit Anaheim.net/ADUexpress for more information.

targets.label: Sewer verification
targets.text: 1. SEWER DEFICIENCY VERIFICATION: Provide a copy of written verification from the Public Works Department verifying that there is sewer capacity to add an ADU to the property. This written verification may be obtained by submitting an email request to the Public Works Department to PWPermits@anaheim.net. Please allow up to four days to receive a reply to your email inquiry.

targets.label: Meter spot report
targets.text: 2. METER SPOT REPORT: Complete this step if you are adding a new electric meter, upgrading an existing meter, and/or relocating an existing meter. Request a meter sport report inspection online (Anaheim.net/3472) or by calling 714-765-6847. A utility inspector will contact you within two to three business days and provide you a copy of the meter spot report. Include the meter spot report on your building plan check submittal.

targets.label: New address request
targets.text: 3. NEW ADDRESS REQUEST: Complete this step prior to plan submittal to avoid any time delays. Submit a completed New Address Request Application and site plan to BusinessAssistance@anaheim.net. You will be contacted via email with a link for payment on the AnaheimNext website. If submitting in-person, please arrive by 11:00 am to ensure same day processing.

targets.label: Owner occupancy covenant (JADU)
targets.text: 1. OWNER OCCUPANCY COVENANT: AMC Section 18.38.015.110 requires the recordation of an owner occupancy covenant for all JADUs, authorized by the California Government Code Sections 65852.2 and 65852.22. The covenant for the JADU will be drafted by the City Attorney’s office and must be recorded with the Orange County Clerk-Recorder’s office prior to the issuance of a building permit. The covenant will specify the following, at a minimum: • The JADU shall not be sold or owned separately from the main dwelling and the parcel upon which the unit is located and shall not be subdivided in any manner that would authorize such sale or ownership; • Owner occupancy is required within one of the dwelling units on the property; and • Owner occupancy shall be binding upon any successor in ownership of the property. Email the following documents to your assigned project Planner as soon as possible for the City to verify current ownership of the property. The current owner(s) will be listed in the covenant and will be requested to sign covenant at the City Clerk’s office:

targets.label: Title report (JADU)
targets.text: TITLE REPORT (Must have been prepared within the last 6 months of submittal date)

targets.label: Applicant signature
targets.text: I hereby certify, under penalty of perjury, that all of the foregoing information is true and correct and acknowledge that any false or misleading information shall be grounds for denial of this application. Furthermore, I agree to fully reimburse the City for the full cost of processing this application.

targets.label: Owner signature
targets.text: I have read and understand the obligations regarding the filing and processing of the attached application. I HEREBY CERTIFY that I am the legal property owner of record or his/her authorized representative and acknowledge and authorize the person(s) named above as applicant and agent to represent me and bind me in all matters concerning this Accessory Dwelling Unit Permit. targets.label: Impact fees for ADUs
targets.text: ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS SEE NOTE BELOW VARIES* *PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 66324, ADU’s ARE EXEMPT FROM INCURRING IMPACT FEES FROM LOCAL AGENCIES, SPECIAL DISTRICTS AND WATER CORPORATIONS IF SUCH UNIT IS LESS THAN 750 SQ FT. IF AN ADU IS 750 SQ FT OR LARGER, IMPACT FEES SHALL BE CHARGED PROPORTIONATELY IN RELATION TO THE SF OF THE ADU TO THE SF OF THE PRIMARY DWELLING UNIT.

steps.title: Organize your files
steps.summary: Your packet holds three made-up files, each listed with the type it was uploaded as.

steps.title: Read the city checklist
steps.summary: Planning reviews ADUs during the Building Division's plan check, and new detached ADUs may be eligible for the ADU Express Program.

steps.title: Application: project information
steps.summary: The ADU Express Application starts with the project address and the accessory dwelling unit address.

steps.title: Application: applicant
steps.summary: The applicant gives a name, company name, phone number, e-mail address and mailing address.

steps.title: Application: property owner
steps.summary: The property owner gives a name, company name if applicable, phone number, e-mail address and mailing address.

steps.title: Application: existing home
steps.summary: The form asks for the total square footage of the existing primary dwelling and its total bedrooms and bathrooms.

steps.title: Application: proposed ADU
steps.summary: The form asks for the floor plan selected, the elevation style, the total square footage and the number of bedrooms.

steps.title: Application: signatures
steps.summary: The applicant certifies under penalty of perjury and agrees to reimburse the City's processing cost; the owner certifies they are the owner of record or an authorized representative.

steps.title: Gather what's due before plan check
steps.summary: Before building plan check, the checklist asks for sewer capacity verification, a meter spot report if a meter is added, upgraded or moved, and a new address request.

steps.title: Check the law the checklist cites
steps.summary: For JADUs, the checklist requires a recorded owner occupancy covenant and cites Government Code Sections 65852.2 and 65852.22.

steps.title: Impact fees by size
steps.summary: The impact fee sheet says ADUs under 750 sq ft are exempt from impact fees, citing Government Code Section 66324.

steps.title: Final check: JADU-only items
steps.summary: The checklist asks for a title report and a grant deed for JADUs.

steps.title: Final check: your packet
steps.summary: Your packet holds three made-up files.
